_readme: The name of every chat, so 'the second tennis one' is never a question
anyone has to answer from memory six weeks later.
Hand-edited. Every run of dictator.bat compares it against WORKSTREAMS in
scan.py and reports anything in one list and not the other. The two are
NOT merged, because they answer different questions: WORKSTREAMS says
which folders belong to which workstream; this says what each chat is
called and what to type in it. Comparing catches drift. It does not
prevent it -- the fee formula reached 17 copies while its rule was a
name     what a human calls it. Unique. Shown everywhere.
slug     the short code. Must match the mailbox folder and BRIEF section.
folders  the folders this chat is allowed to work in.
purpose  one plain sentence. What this chat is FOR.
opening  the exact words to type in that window on a normal day.
subjects what this chat is ABOUT, in words an idea might use. Used to
route a new idea. Add words here rather than tuning code.
created  the date the chat was named.

chats.name: Tennis — paper forward test
chats.purpose: Runs the live tennis paper test and everything about Kalshi tennis markets.

chats.name: Baseball — paper forward test
chats.purpose: Runs the live baseball paper test, 16 bots, watching closing-line value.

chats.name: De-vig, weather and crypto market making
chats.purpose: Tests whether bookmaker prices, weather models or resting orders beat Kalshi.

chats.name: Signal hunting — GitHub, YouTube, social
chats.purpose: Finds and grades what other people have already built and published.

chats.name: Dictator — the chat you talk to
chats.purpose: Reports where everything is, checks ideas against past work, files instructions. Does no project work.

chats.name: Soccer — comeback rates against Kalshi's price
chats.purpose: Counts how often a losing team comes back, by minute, scoreline, league and team strength, and compares it to what Kalshi charges.
chats.opening: you are the soccer chat, check your mail

chats.name: Reopen — things closed for the wrong reason
chats.purpose: Audits every closed claim in the ledger for threads killed by a bug, missing data, or a test too small to see the thing it declared absent.
chats.opening: you are the reopen chat, check your mail

chats.name: Live desk — the one-window baseball trade display
chats.purpose: Builds the on-screen window that shows the next baseball bet, its size, its guards and its own running profit and loss. Displays only - it never sends an order.
chats.opening: you are the livedesk chat, check your mail
